Researching for a dissertation while studying accounting?

We’ve created a list of potential dissertation titles that are worthwhile and relevant for students, academics and researchers in India, as they reflect the new financial, regulatory, and technology changes affecting the Indian and global accounting profession. Whether you are completing an undergraduate, postgraduate, or doctoral research project, these dissertation topic project ideas are an excellent place for you to start your research topic! The Importance of Budgetary Control Systems on Strategic Decision-Making for Indian Firms Human Capital Accounting in India: a review of disclosures on Intellectual Capital Challenges to Auditor Independence in Small and Medium Audit Firms in India Exploring the Inadequate Role of Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs) on infrastructure development in India Is fair value accounting at fault in the demise of Indian NBFCs during periods of financial stress? Regulatory Disparity in Reporting Financial Activities in India vs other banking systems globally The impact of India’s IT boom on auditing methodologies and risk assessment models Is Globalisation always good? A case of Indian Corporates into the south-east Asian region Re-defining audit competency in order to improve governance performance within the public sector in India Graduate Reflection: Communications, Ethics, and self-awareness in accounting practice in India Earnings Management and Corporate Governance: Pre-and Post-Indias 2016 Demonetisation If any of these topics’ thoughts have sparked something, that is a perfect start! To help you prepare when you feel confident, we now have our guide, How to Write a Dissertation Title, which can help you create a concise, engaging topic for your final degree project.
